item.title: Buffalo embraces winter with new ‘Made for Snowbuffs’ advertising campaign
item.description: What’s the opposite of snowbird? Could it be “snowbuff?” A new pro-winter-in-Buffalo campaign is underway to demonstrate that this city embraces its winter fully and unapologetically.
